name: Chargebee API
tagline: Subscription billing and revenue management API for SaaS and ecommerce
description: Chargebee provides a REST API for subscription billing, invoicing, payments, customers, and revenue operations. Developers integrate to manage plans, subscriptions, one-time charges, invoices, and payment methods for recurring revenue products.

auth.details: API key via HTTP Basic Auth (API key as username, empty password); keys created in Chargebee admin console

use_cases: create a subscription for a customer
